tasks.label: restore
args: if (-not (Get-Command nuget -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { $nugetUrl = 'https://dist.nuget.org/win-x86-commandline/latest/nuget.exe'; $nugetDir = "${env:USERPROFILE}\.nuget"; $nugetExe = "$nugetDir\nuget.exe"; if (-not (Test-Path $nugetExe)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $nugetDir -Force | Out-Null; Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $nugetUrl -OutFile $nugetExe }; & $nugetExe restore DBScripter.sln } else { nuget restore DBScripter.sln }

tasks.label: build
args: if (Get-Command msbuild -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { $msbuild = 'msbuild' } else { $vs = & "${env:ProgramFiles(x86)}\Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe" -latest -property installationPath 2>$null; $msbuild = "$vs\MSBuild\Current\Bin\MSBuild.exe" }; & $msbuild DBScripter.sln /p:Configuration=Debug /p:Platform=x86 /m /verbosity:minimal

tasks.label: rebuild
args: if (Get-Command msbuild -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { $msbuild = 'msbuild' } else { $vs = & "${env:ProgramFiles(x86)}\Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe" -latest -property installationPath 2>$null; $msbuild = "$vs\MSBuild\Current\Bin\MSBuild.exe" }; & $msbuild DBScripter.sln /t:Clean;Build /p:Configuration=Debug /p:Platform=x86 /m /verbosity:minimal
